verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs say self-hosting runs the complete platform on your own infrastructure with full control over your data (docs-12, docs-53). They document Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift Helm deployment paths (docs-13, docs-54, docs-55), plus a self-hosted Edge Proxy that keeps flag evaluation close to your servers (docs-14, docs-28). The public GitHub repository implies an open-source distribution. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement and clarity on feature parity between the open-source and enterprise self-hosted editions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full self-hosted deployment.
